rules: Listings come from archived public Etsy market pages for Ethiopian pillows and sefed, plus archived wall-decor listings from those sellers. Each product keeps the Etsy category it was listed in: pillows and cushion covers are cushions, wall hangings and wall decor are wall art, and floor rugs are rugs. A mesob is a coffee table only when the listing states a table-sized width. Clothing, jewelry, digital downloads, kits, table linens and gabi blankets are left out, because this room planner has no slot for them. Photos stay on i.etsystatic.com and are the seller's listing photo, at least 512 px on the short side. Prices are the US dollar price on the archived .com page.
